description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for managing and resolving an inventory of tools within an agent framework, including categorization, labeling, and model compatibility.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveToolLabel
methods.description: Determines the display label for a given tool, prioritizing the tool's label or falling back to a resolved display title.

methods.name: resolveRawToolDescription
methods.description: Retrieves and trims the raw description string of a tool.

methods.name: summarizeToolDescription
methods.description: Generates a summarized description of a tool based on its raw description and display settings.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveToolSource
methods.description: Identifies the source category (core, plugin, channel) of a tool and associated metadata.

methods.name: groupLabel
methods.description: Provides a human-readable label for a group of tools based on their source category.

methods.name: disambiguateLabels
methods.description: Ensures tool labels are unique by appending suffixes when duplicates exist.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveModelCompat
methods.description: Resolves model compatibility information based on provided parameters.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveToolInventory
methods.description: Main function that compiles and returns the inventory of tools available to an agent, categorized and labeled appropriately.
